```yaml
name: Debug OCI Images

on:
  push:
    branches: [ develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ develop ]
    types: [ opened, synchronize, reopened ]

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    name: Build and Test OCI Image
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@08eba0b27e820071cde6df949e0beb9ba4906955 # v4

      - name: Setup Ruby environment
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@473e4d8fe5dd94ee32d87161db317a5195a41663 # v1
        with:
          bundler-cache: true
          ruby-version: '3.4.7'

      - name: Setup Node.js environment
        uses: actions/setup-node@1a4442cacd436585143658d427a027115111051d # v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pnpm install
          bundle install

      - name: Setup Valkey for testing
        run: |
          pnpm run test:database:start:bg
          sleep 2
          pnpm run test:database:status

      - name: Run Ruby tests
        run: |
          bundle exec rspec spec/

      - name: Run TypeScript tests
        run: |
          pnpm run test:base

      - name: Run Playwright E2E tests
        run: |
          pnpm run test:playwright

      - name: Run Tryouts
        run: |
          pnpm run test:tryouts:agent

      - name: Clean up Valkey
        run: |
          pnpm run test:database:stop

      - name: Build OCI image
        run: |
          docker build --build-arg=VERSION=0.24.1-debug -t onetimesecret-debug .

      - name: Push OCI image
        run: |
          echo ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} | docker login ghcr.io -u ${{ github.actor }} --password-stdin
          docker tag onetimesecret-debug ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}:debug
          docker push ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}:debug
```
